brick: the engine/runtime for a canvas game in the Ellaz web portal
constraint: web only — PC + mobile + tablet browsers

droppedCells.reason: GUI-only Electron build pipeline + account login; the only engine that cannot build headlessly in CI

fidelity.gate: all arms reproduce the golden checksum

correction.trigger: operator reported the Defold panel was blank
correction.what: Defold ran the full simulation and passed the checksum but drew nothing — no visual layer had been built. A GUI layer was added and the arm re-measured.
correction.effect: Defold FPS moved from EXCLUDED to valid, and it became the fastest desktop renderer in the grid.

validityLimits: Godot FPS is implementation-limited — the arm used immediate-mode _draw(); idiomatic Godot would use Sprite2D/MultiMesh.
Excalibur FPS is implementation-limited — a new Rectangle was allocated per actor and 300 actors were recreated per burst.
Only phaser, pixi and defold FPS numbers are a fair engine comparison.
readPixels reported 0 lit pixels for an arm that WAS rendering (canvas lacks preserveDrawingBuffer) — screenshots, not pixel counts, verified rendering.
